**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP).**

- **Caps (compliant elements):** §§ 9.1 and 9.2 mirror each other — each party is liable for no more than the greater of $100,000 or charges paid by Customer in the 12 months preceding accrual of the first claim, and § 10 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually. Mutuality, the 12-month fee basis and the damages exclusion are acceptable; the $100,000 floor (vs. USD 1,000,000) and "paid" vs. "paid or payable" are noted only as minor shortfalls of the preferred position.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** the only super-cap items are indemnification payments and bodily injury/tangible property damage. There is no carve-out for breach of confidentiality, gross negligence or willful misconduct — and § 6 makes Sections 5, 9 and 10 prevail over the AECI for confidential information in the hosting environment, while § 9.1(c)(2) excludes all liability for loss of or damage to Customer's records or data.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** inserted a single new § 9.3 "Excluded Claims" after p0121, mutually disapplying the Section 9 limits (including 9.1(c)(2)) for indemnities, confidentiality/data protection/security breaches, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP. No other language in Section 9 or 10 was touched.
